utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m glad we’re doing the repair drive—what do you need help with first?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I usually show up late, but I can start with whatever still needs sorting—boxes, labels, or hauling stuff.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great—let’s start with sorting boxes, and if you can, help me with the labels after that.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you bring your screwdriver set and a flashlight? If you can, please also check the loose hinge on the gate.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring the screwdriver set and flashlight, and I’ll check the gate hinge too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can keep an eye on what supplies we still need for the repair drive. Just tell me what’s already covered and I’ll track the rest.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Cleo — I’ve got a few things covered already, but I’m blanking on the details right now. I’ll check and let you know what’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No problem — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll keep track from there.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I just need the updated list of repairs and who’s handling each one. Once I have that, I can check the timing and make sure nothing gets missed.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’ll pull together the updated repair list and the names for each task, then send it your way.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, I think so — I heard we were still meeting up today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what time are we meeting, and where should I bring the tools?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I haven’t heard the latest yet, Gus—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: We’re kicking off at the community shed Saturday morning—bring your broken bits, and we’ll sort what we can. I’ve got a few tools ready if folks need them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That sounds great, Gus—I’ll spread the word around the block. What time Saturday morning should people show up?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. People around here usually show up when they know it’s for a good cause.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Quinn — I appreciate that. If you hear who’s bringing what, let me know so I can keep track.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Will do — I’ll ask around and let you know who’s bringing what as soon as I hear. We should have a nice turnout for the drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, can you help sort the donations and check the list?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can sort the donations and check the list.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: I’m glad we’re getting this repair drive moving, Bo. I can help keep the list organized and make sure folks know what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, Rosa — that’d help a lot. I’ll start gathering the repair list and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — send me whatever you gather, and I’ll turn it into a clean list for the block.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to help spread the word about the repair drive, and I’ll remind a few neighbors too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds good, Vik. Let’s keep it simple: I’ll note the time and you can remind the neighbors.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sounds good — I’ll remind the neighbors and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I meant to help with that, didn’t I? Tell me what you need, and I’ll do my best to keep up.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. If you can help carry a few things and sort the donations, that would take a lot off my hands.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, I can do that. Point me to the boxes and I’ll start sorting.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help get the repair drive rolling—what still needs to be fixed?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly the old fence by the side lot and that sagging gate out front. If we can get a few folks together, I think we can knock it out.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That sounds doable — I’ll help round up a few people and we can start with the fence and gate.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m helping spread the word about the repair drive—want me to put your name on the list?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, put me down—I might be a little late, but I’ll come by and help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ve got you down, Dane. Swing by whenever you can—we’ll be glad to have you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m listening—what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’ve got a simple plan: we’ll sort the donations, then check what still needs fixing. If you want, I can walk you through the list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good—I’d like the walkthrough. Let’s start with the list.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school pickup times—what’s the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be a huge help—let’s set the repair drive for after school pickup, maybe 4:30 to 6:00, and I’ll start a sign-up list for tools and volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Perfect, 4:30 to 6:00 works for me—I can help spread the word and line up a few parents after pickup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help connect folks for the repair drive—what’s the best way I can pitch in?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Jules — could you spread the word and help line up a few volunteers for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and see who can volunteer. If you have any key details or a sign-up link, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand and bring over a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’d help a lot, Gus. Just tell me what time you can come by so I can make sure everything’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can swing by around 3 and bring my toolbox. If that works, I’ll see you then.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can keep an eye on where we leave things for the repair drive—just tell me the drop-off spot and I’ll remember it.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal—that’s a big help. Let’s use the front porch table as the drop-off spot so everything stays easy to find.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll note the front porch table as the drop-off spot and keep an eye on it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, we’re still on. Could you bring the screwdriver set and the extra tape, just to be safe?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Of course — I’ll bring the screwdriver set and extra tape. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with the repair drive — what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — we’re short on screws, a hammer, and some duct tape. If you can bring those, that’d really help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll bring screws, a hammer, and duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I haven’t heard the latest on the repair drive yet—what’s the update?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — I think it’s still going on, but I may have missed the latest details. I should check and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Noah — I’d appreciate that. Just let me know when you hear more.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is still on, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, still on — folks are bringing by tools, parts, and a few donated appliances.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, just confirming — same place and same time as planned?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Oh, I’ve been hearing bits about the repair drive while I’m out and about—sounds like folks are really stepping up. How’s it going on your end?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: It’s going along, I think. Quietly, mostly—I’m just grateful people are showing up.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s good to hear—I’m glad it’s steady and people are pitching in. If you hear what still needs doing, let me know while I’m out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I might be a bit foggy, but I’m happy to help out. What do you need me to bring or do?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — could you bring a screwdriver and a roll of tape? If you can also help sort the donated parts when you get here, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: You got it — screwdriver, tape, and I’ll help sort the donated parts too. If I forget anything, just remind me when I get there!
